rows.description: A senior engineer works alone for hours, refusing to hand over. Fatigue leads to a wrong command that prolongs the outage, showing how pride and tunnel vision can extend a crisis.

rows.description: After recovery, the team writes a timeline, finds root causes in the missing alert and untested rollback, and lists actions with owners, focusing on system improvements not on punishing individuals.

rows.description: Following the outage, the team schedules quarterly failure drills where a service is deliberately disabled in a test setting, so that the response steps become familiar before the real thing.
